name: Home Delivered Meals
description: Meals prepared in Highland Valley Elder Services' kitchen and delivered to older adults at home. Meals are free to those who qualify; donations are accepted. Evening and weekend meals are also available.
contact: (413) 586-2000; 320 Riverside Drive, Suite B, Florence, MA 01062

requirements.text: Highland Valley Elder Services lists 24 towns it serves, including Amherst: Amherst, Blandford, Chester, Chesterfield, Cummington, Easthampton, Goshen, Granville, Hadley, Hatfield, Huntington, Middlefield, Montgomery, Northampton, Pelham, Plainfield, Russell, Southampton, Southwick, Tolland, Westfield, Westhampton, Williamsburg, Worthington.
The page says the Nutrition Program aims for every person over 60 to receive at least one nutritionally balanced meal each day; it does not state an exact qualifying age for home-delivered meals.
Meals are free to all who qualify. The page does not list the qualification rules; call (413) 586-2000.

unknowns: Exact eligibility rules (homebound status, age cut-off, income) are not stated on the page.
Delivery days and whether delivery reaches every address in Amherst are not stated on the meals page.

Not every town in Hampshire County is on the agency's 24-town list (e.g. it is unclear whether Belchertown, Granby, South Hadley or Ware residents are served); residency is a town list, not a whole county.
Service area limited to ZIP codes whose postal city is a town on the HVES list; village ZIP codes (e.g. Florence, Leeds, Haydenville) may also be served but are not listed. Call to confirm.

first_step.title: Ask about home-delivered meals
first_step.detail: Call Highland Valley Elder Services at (413) 586-2000, or send a referral online.
